instruction: Candid corporate photograph, medium shot from a slightly low angle. In a minimalist office, five colleagues stack their hands together in a low huddle. From left to right: the blonde woman in a white shirt (R4) in profile, the woman in a plaid blazer (R2) facing right, the dark-haired woman in a beige sweater (R3) facing forward, the wavy-haired blonde woman in a white cable-knit sweater (R1) facing left, and the young man in a white shirt (R5) in profile. They are all smiling as they extend their arms downward to join hands. Bright, even indoor lighting fills the space.
elements: R1 faces left while extending her arm downward into the shared hand stack
R2 faces right while extending her arm downward into the shared hand stack
R3 faces forward while joining the low hand huddle
R4 is in profile while participating in the hand stack
R5 is in profile while participating in the hand stack
The group is in a minimalist office
